title: Ron Tototz in the surf at Nha Trang
description: Ron Tototz walks up the sand out of heavy churned surf at Nha Trang beach, near beach hut #3 or #4 — the hut run by two girls selling soda pop, beer, and shrimp. Larry attaches a darker memory to this stretch of water: a medic went out into it and was pulled under.
researchNotes: Larry's own accounts (Memories comments, 2026-08-15 and 2026-09-03; giscus-vn-0021-c18032383.json, -c18259987.json). The drowned medic is an open research question (ledger #14, issue #61), and which state he came from is a question still to be put to Larry; the searches run, their scope and negatives, and how his two accounts differ are kept in research/people/drowned-medic-nha-trang.md and the ledger, not summarised here (2026-09-14: the description no longer names a state). Larry's placement at Nha Trang agrees with the survey's hypothesis for this beach series; the placement rests on his words, not the survey.
